title: DB
description: The Lending domain's SQLite database (node:sqlite), at the file the DB environment variable names, which the library runs itself; in memory when DB is not set, as in the tests. `Database.transaction` runs each command's change and its outbox events in one transaction.

title: memory
description: The server's own memory: the catalog and the outcome measures are worked out from the database on each request or report, and nothing of them is kept between runs.
